Fit an exchangeable-frailty split-population survival model

Source: R/fit.R
stan_exchange_spsurv.Rd

Fits a Bayesian split-population survival model with exchangeable (iid normal) group-level frailties for both the survival and split stages.

stan_exchange_spsurv(
  formula,
  split_formula,
  data,
  group,
  spell = NULL,
  form = c("weibull", "loglogistic"),
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

Survival-stage formula with a two-column response Surv(time, event).

split_formula

Formula for the latent susceptibility probability.

data

A data frame.

group

Group identifier, supplied as a column name or vector.

spell

Episode identifier. Required for counting-process responses; split-stage covariates must be constant within each episode.

form

Event-time distribution: "weibull" or "loglogistic".

...

Sampling arguments passed to the CmdStan sampler (e.g., chains, iter_warmup, iter_sampling, seed).

Value

An object of class stanSPsurv.

Examples

# \donttest{
library(survival)
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘survival’
#> The following object is masked from ‘package:stanSPsurv’:
#> 
#>     frailty
data(lung)
#> Warning: data set ‘lung’ not found
lung$inst <- factor(lung$inst)
fit <- stan_exchange_spsurv(
  Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex,
  split_formula = ~ age,
  data = lung, group = inst,
  form = "weibull",
  chains = 2, iter_warmup = 200, iter_sampling = 200
)
